attributes.label: Date_Time
attributes.definition: The date and time are reported in the format mm/dd/year hh:mm. Time is reported in international standard ISO 8601

attributes.label: Record_Number
attributes.definition: Sequential number assigned to row by computer

attributes.label: Wind_Speed_Low_mph
attributes.definition: Wind speed measured at approximately 20 cm AGL, sampled at one second intervals, one sample value reported each minute in mph.

attributes.label: Wind_Speed_Mid_mph
attributes.definition: Wind speed measured at approximately 60 cm AGL, sampled at one second intervals, one sample value reported each minute in mph.

attributes.label: Wind_Speed_High_mph
attributes.definition: Wind speed measured at approximately 1 m AGL, sampled at one second intervals, one sample value reported each minute in mph.

attributes.label: Particle_Count_Tot_1
attributes.definition: Total particle count for one-minute interval, measured by Sensit. Approximately 12 cm AGL. The count saturates at 7999, and so can underestimate particle movement during high wind events.

attributes.label: Particle_Count_Tot_2
attributes.definition: Total particle count for one-minute interval, measured by Sensit. Approximately 12 cm AGL. The count saturates at 7999, and so can underestimate particle movement during high wind events.

attributes.label: Particle_Count_Tot_3
attributes.definition: Total particle count for one-minute interval, measured by Sensit. Approximately 12 cm AGL. The count saturates at 7999, and so can underestimate particle movement during high wind events.

attributes.label: Kinetic_Energy_Tot_1
attributes.definition: A measure of the energy that has impacted the Sensit, reported in uncalibrated instrument units. It is the total recorded for the one-minute interval.

attributes.label: Kinetic_Energy_Tot_2
attributes.definition: A measure of the energy that has impacted the Sensit, reported in uncalibrated instrument units. It is the total recorded for the one-minute interval.

attributes.label: Kinetic_Energy_Tot_3
attributes.definition: A measure of the energy that has impacted the Sensit, reported in uncalibrated instrument units. It is the total recorded for the one-minute interval.

attributes.label: wBSNE_1_average
attributes.definition: Voltage was measured at one second intervals and averaged over one minute. Instrument located approximately 20 cm AGL, reported in mV/V.

attributes.label: wBSNE_2_average
attributes.definition: Voltage was measured at one second intervals and averaged over one minute. Instrument located approximately 20 cm AGL, reported in mV/V.

attributes.label: wBSNE_3_average
attributes.definition: Voltage was measured at one second intervals and averaged over one minute. Instrument located approximately XX cm AGL, reported in mV/V.
